name: LUNCH
summary: A fashion-editorial commerce system with a dark full-bleed hero, one chrome wordmark spectacle, warm parchment catalog sections, sharp product photography, text-link interactions, and lilac used only as quiet brand punctuation.
coreMoves: Use a full-bleed dark photographic hero.
Use one oversized hero wordmark as the only typographic spectacle.
Switch post-hero content to warm parchment.
Make all interactions underlined text links.
Keep images and cards at 0px radius.
Use Lilac Veil only for announcement, footer, and sold-out state.
Let photography do the visual work.
